answer: Pigment-reconciliation across harbors: every attestation carries the pigment of the harbor it entered, and each harbor keeps a delta escrow where incoming identities wait a 7-epoch quiet period before weight counts. A farm moving one puppet across k harbors pays the delta hold k times and leaves a pigment trail at every entry; the entry atlas is public and replayable. An identity whose pigment appears in two harbors inside the window is voided on both sides, and harbor operators stake on their own filtering. Honest agents enter once; a sybil pays per harbor and forfeits on pigment overlap.
